mapper.select: INSERT INTO daily_intake ( user_id, intake_name, image_url, source_of_intake, portion, created_by, updated_by, created_ts, updated_ts ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{intakeName}, #{imageUrl}, #{sourceOfIntake}, #{portion}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, COALESCE(#{createdTs}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedTs}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO food_item ( daily_intake_id, item_name, canonical_name, quantity_value, quantity_unit, portion, dietary_type, created_ts ) VALUES ( #{dailyIntakeId}, #{itemName}, #{canonicalName}, #{quantityValue}, #{quantityUnit}, #{portion}, #{dietaryType}, COALESCE(#{createdTs}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) RETURNING id

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, intake_name AS intakeName, source_of_intake AS sourceOfIntake, image_url AS imageUrl, portion, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_ts AS createdTs, updated_ts AS updatedTs, COALESCE(created_ts, created_at) AS createdAt FROM daily_intake WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(COALESCE(created_ts, created_at)) = #{date}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, intake_name AS intakeName, source_of_intake AS sourceOfIntake, image_url AS imageUrl, portion, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_ts AS createdTs, updated_ts AS updatedTs, COALESCE(created_ts, created_at) AS createdAt FROM daily_intake WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(COALESCE(created_ts, created_at)) >= #{fromDate} AND DATE(COALESCE(created_ts, created_at)) <= #{toDate}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, intake_name AS intakeName, source_of_intake AS sourceOfIntake, image_url AS imageUrl, portion, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_ts AS createdTs, updated_ts AS updatedTs, COALESCE(created_ts, created_at) AS createdAt FROM daily_intake WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{dailyIntakeId}

SELECT fi.id, COALESCE(fi.item_name, fia.display_name, fi.canonical_name) AS itemName, fi.canonical_name AS canonicalName, fi.quantity_value AS quantityValue, fi.quantity_unit AS quantityUnit, fi.portion, fi.daily_intake_id AS dailyIntakeId, fi.created_ts AS createdTs, fid.calories_value_per_100g AS caloriesValuePer100g, fid.calories_unit AS caloriesUnit, fid.protein_value_per_100g AS proteinValuePer100g, fid.protein_unit AS proteinUnit, fid.total_carbohydrate_value_per_100g AS totalCarbohydrateValuePer100g, fid.total_carbohydrate_unit AS totalCarbohydrateUnit, fid.total_fat_value_per_100g AS totalFatValuePer100g, fid.total_fat_unit AS totalFatUnit, fid.dietary_fiber_value_per_100g AS dietaryFiberValuePer100g, fid.dietary_fiber_unit AS dietaryFiberUnit, fid.total_sugars_value_per_100g AS totalSugarsValuePer100g, fid.total_sugars_unit AS totalSugarsUnit, fid.sodium_value_per_100g AS sodiumValuePer100g, fid.sodium_unit AS sodiumUnit, fid.iron_value_per_100g AS ironValuePer100g, fid.iron_unit AS ironUnit FROM food_item fi LEFT JOIN food_item_dictionary fid ON fi.canonical_name = fid.canonical_name LEFT JOIN food_item_alias fia ON fi.canonical_name = fia.canonical_name AND fia.country_code = #{countryCode} WHERE fi.daily_intake_id = #{dailyIntakeId}

INSERT INTO product_label ( product_name, category, total_quantity_value, total_quantity_unit, serving_size_value, serving_size_unit, energy_value_per_100g, energy_unit, protein_value_per_100g, protein_unit, total_carbohydrate_value_per_100g, total_carbohydrate_unit, total_fat_value_per_100g, total_fat_unit, saturated_fat_value_per_100g, saturated_fat_unit, trans_fat_value_per_100g, trans_fat_unit, dietary_fiber_value_per_100g, dietary_fiber_unit, total_sugars_value_per_100g, total_sugars_unit, added_sugars_value_per_100g, added_sugars_unit, sodium_value_per_100g, sodium_unit, iron_value_per_100g, iron_unit, potassium_value_per_100g, potassium_unit, calcium_value_per_100g, calcium_unit, added_by ) VALUES ( #{productName}, #{category}, #{totalQuantityValue}, #{totalQuantityUnit}, #{servingSizeValue}, #{servingSizeUnit}, #{energyValuePer100g}, #{energyUnit}, #{proteinValuePer100g}, #{proteinUnit}, #{totalCarbohydrateValuePer100g}, #{totalCarbohydrateUnit}, #{totalFatValuePer100g}, #{totalFatUnit}, #{saturatedFatValuePer100g}, #{saturatedFatUnit}, #{transFatValuePer100g}, #{transFatUnit}, #{dietaryFiberValuePer100g}, #{dietaryFiberUnit}, #{totalSugarsValuePer100g}, #{totalSugarsUnit}, #{addedSugarsValuePer100g}, #{addedSugarsUnit}, #{sodiumValuePer100g}, #{sodiumUnit}, #{ironValuePer100g}, #{ironUnit}, #{potassiumValuePer100g}, #{potassiumUnit}, #{calciumValuePer100g}, #{calciumUnit}, #{addedBy} ) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_concern_recommendation ( concern_id, food, quantity, reasoning ) VALUES ( #{concernId}, #{food}, #{quantity}, #{reasoning} )
mapper.select: SELECT fid.id, fia.display_name AS itemName, fid.canonical_name AS canonicalName, fid.calories_value_per_100g AS caloriesValuePer100g, fid.calories_unit AS caloriesUnit, fid.protein_value_per_100g AS proteinValuePer100g, fid.protein_unit AS proteinUnit, fid.total_carbohydrate_value_per_100g AS totalCarbohydrateValuePer100g, fid.total_carbohydrate_unit AS totalCarbohydrateUnit, fid.total_fat_value_per_100g AS totalFatValuePer100g, fid.total_fat_unit AS totalFatUnit, fid.dietary_fiber_value_per_100g AS dietaryFiberValuePer100g, fid.dietary_fiber_unit AS dietaryFiberUnit, fid.total_sugars_value_per_100g AS totalSugarsValuePer100g, fid.total_sugars_unit AS totalSugarsUnit, fid.sodium_value_per_100g AS sodiumValuePer100g, fid.sodium_unit AS sodiumUnit, fid.iron_value_per_100g AS ironValuePer100g, fid.iron_unit AS ironUnit FROM food_item_dictionary fid INNER JOIN food_item_alias fia ON fid.canonical_name = fia.canonical_name WHERE LOWER(fia.display_name) = LOWER(#{displayName}) AND fia.country_code = #{countryCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, canonical_name AS itemName, canonical_name AS canonicalName, calories_value_per_100g AS caloriesValuePer100g, calories_unit AS caloriesUnit, protein_value_per_100g AS proteinValuePer100g, protein_unit AS proteinUnit, total_carbohydrate_value_per_100g AS totalCarbohydrateValuePer100g, total_carbohydrate_unit AS totalCarbohydrateUnit, total_fat_value_per_100g AS totalFatValuePer100g, total_fat_unit AS totalFatUnit, dietary_fiber_value_per_100g AS dietaryFiberValuePer100g, dietary_fiber_unit AS dietaryFiberUnit, total_sugars_value_per_100g AS totalSugarsValuePer100g, total_sugars_unit AS totalSugarsUnit, sodium_value_per_100g AS sodiumValuePer100g, sodium_unit AS sodiumUnit, iron_value_per_100g AS ironValuePer100g, iron_unit AS ironUnit FROM food_item_dictionary WHERE canonical_name = #{canonicalName} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_item_alias (canonical_name, country_code, display_name) VALUES (#{canonicalName}, #{countryCode}, #{displayName}) ON CONFLICT (canonical_name, country_code) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO food_item_dictionary ( canonical_name, calories_value_per_100g, calories_unit, protein_value_per_100g, protein_unit, total_carbohydrate_value_per_100g, total_carbohydrate_unit, total_fat_value_per_100g, total_fat_unit, dietary_fiber_value_per_100g, dietary_fiber_unit, total_sugars_value_per_100g, total_sugars_unit, sodium_value_per_100g, sodium_unit, iron_value_per_100g, iron_unit, dietary_type, verified_ind ) VALUES ( #{canonicalName}, #{caloriesValuePer100g}, #{caloriesUnit}, #{proteinValuePer100g}, #{proteinUnit}, #{totalCarbohydrateValuePer100g}, #{totalCarbohydrateUnit}, #{totalFatValuePer100g}, #{totalFatUnit}, #{dietaryFiberValuePer100g}, #{dietaryFiberUnit}, #{totalSugarsValuePer100g}, #{totalSugarsUnit}, #{sodiumValuePer100g}, #{sodiumUnit}, #{ironValuePer100g}, #{ironUnit}, #{dietaryType}, COALESCE(#{verifiedInd}, FALSE) ) ON CONFLICT (canonical_name) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO meal_dictionary ( canonical_meal_name, display_meal_name, recipe_items, standard_quantity_value, standard_quantity_unit, calories_value, calories_unit, protein_value, protein_unit, total_carbohydrate_value, total_carbohydrate_unit, total_fat_value, total_fat_unit, dietary_fiber_value, dietary_fiber_unit, total_sugars_value, total_sugars_unit, sodium_value, sodium_unit, verified_ind, created_by_user_id ) VALUES ( #{canonicalMealName}, #{displayMealName}, #{recipeItems, typeHandler=com.scanmyfood.backend.mapper.RecipeItemListTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{standardQuantityValue}, #{standardQuantityUnit}, #{caloriesValue}, #{caloriesUnit}, #{proteinValue}, #{proteinUnit}, #{totalCarbohydrateValue}, #{totalCarbohydrateUnit}, #{totalFatValue}, #{totalFatUnit}, #{dietaryFiberValue}, #{dietaryFiberUnit}, #{totalSugarsValue}, #{totalSugarsUnit}, #{sodiumValue}, #{sodiumUnit}, COALESCE(#{verifiedInd}, FALSE), #{createdByUserId} ) ON CONFLICT (canonical_meal_name) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, canonical_meal_name, display_meal_name, recipe_items, standard_quantity_value, standard_quantity_unit, calories_value, calories_unit, protein_value, protein_unit, total_carbohydrate_value, total_carbohydrate_unit, total_fat_value, total_fat_unit, dietary_fiber_value, dietary_fiber_unit, total_sugars_value, total_sugars_unit, sodium_value, sodium_unit, verified_ind, created_by_user_id, created_at FROM meal_dictionary WHERE canonical_meal_name = #{canonicalMealName} LIMIT 1
